text:
Maya (PM): kicking off a short sync — we need a concrete plan for the next design-partner onramp. target: 6 partners over 6 weeks. thoughts on recruitment cadence + acceptance gates?
Devon (Eng): 6 in 6 wks seems doable if we cap integration depth. recommend 30m tech intake + 1-week sandbox trial as a hard gate.
Ashwin (Solutions): agree. propose prioritizing partners with existing infra parity (k8s + S3) to reduce ops churn. also ask for a short sample payload and QPS expectation up front.
Riley (Research): we should predefine our eval signals. suggest: latency P95, token-cost delta vs baseline, prompt-regression score on 10 control prompts. want to own the eval harness.
Connie (Ops): onboarding checklist draft: onboarding call, creds/KMS check, VPC peering steps, test corpus upload, smoke-run. ops lead must be assigned before slot confirm.
Maya (PM): nice — can we distill to "must-have" acceptance criteria? keep it short for outreach message.
Devon (Eng): quick draft criteria block:```
- Infra parity confirmed (k8s/S3 or cloud storage)
- Assigned technical POC + availability windows
- Baseline traffic profile (sample payload + qps)
- Security checklist cleared (KMS/NDAs)
- Willingness to run 1-2 short eval prompts weekly
```
Ashwin (Solutions): outreach messaging idea: "early onboarders get prioritized rollout, 1:1 support, and influence on perf tuning". maybe offer 2 months pro-bono Dedicated credits.
Riley (Research): add that we’ll share blinded aggregated eval results to participants — that’s often a motivator.
Maya (PM): budget question — Connie, any ops capacity for 6 partners in parallel?
Connie (Ops): can handle 2 full onboardings concurrently without extra headcount. beyond that we need temp SE support or slow cadence. recommend staggered waves of 2 -> 2 -> 2.
Maya (PM): ok that implies a 3-wave plan over 6 weeks. Outreach schedule: week 0 outreach, week 1 tech intake, week 2 sandbox, week 3 pilot evaluations.
Devon (Eng): gating note: if sandbox reveals model-compat issues (quantization/latency mismatches), we should have automated fallback to hosted variant to keep partner engaged. put that in runbook.
Ashwin (Solutions): will compile a prioritized partner list — targeting 2 fintech, 2 SaaS, 2 marketplace. will include contact intro copy.
Maya (PM): what's the minimum signal to graduate a partner from "pilot" to "beta"? Riley?
Riley (Research): graduation criteria: 1) avg prompt regression < 2% on control set, 2) P95 latency within SLA (<=400ms), 3) inferred cost per 1k tokens within 20% of baseline, 4) partner signs short-term rollout commitment.
Devon (Eng): add stability: <2% error rate across 48h smoke-run.
Connie (Ops): include ops handoff checkbox: document runbook, creds rotated, monitoring alerts configured.
Maya (PM): timeline + owners then:
- Outreach message + list: Ashwin by EOD Tue
- Intake scheduling & tech gating: Devon + Solutions by Thur
- Ops checklist prep & runbook template: Connie by Fri
- Eval harness + control prompts: Riley by next Wed
- Outreach send: Maya Thu next week
Ashwin (Solutions): ack — will ping list and surface top 8 candidates (so we can drop to 6).
Devon (Eng): I'll draft the sandbox quickstart (1 pager) and include automated fallback instructions.
Riley (Research): need a quick review loop for prompts. can do 30m with Maya + Ashwin next Tue.
Maya (PM): one more ask — wording for outreach should be concise (<150 chars) with clear asks. Draft suggestion: "Join Redwood early onramp: 6 partners, 6 weeks. Get Dedicated credits, priority tuning, and shared eval insights. 30m intake + 1wk sandbox. RSVP". thoughts?
Ashwin (Solutions): clean. maybe add "limited slots" and a CTA link.
Connie (Ops): don't promise Dedicated unless procurement is aligned. say "priority tuning" and "trial credits" instead.
Maya (PM): good catch. final draft will say "priority tuning + trial credits".
recruit-bot: new candidate added: "AcmePay" (contact: j.smith@acmepay.com) — tag Ashwin
Ashwin (Solutions): got it, adding to shortlist.
Maya (PM): action items summarized: Ashwin shortlist, Devon sandbox quickstart, Connie ops runbook, Riley eval harness. target outreach next Thu. If no blockers, we'll post follow-up here by Mon COB. :rocket:
